sentence: This project studies how signals from a type of T cell control B cells that make the antibody IgE, which can cause anaphylaxis.
This project builds lipid nanoparticles that carry a drug to calm inflammation and restore immune balance in sepsis.
This project builds a handheld imaging device that lets physicians look at blood vessels in the retina of patients who cannot hold still.
This project screens many molecules to find ones that block two related enzymes linked to cancer and then tests the best candidates.
This project uses sequencing in genetically diverse rats to find gene variants linked to oxycodone use and addiction.
This project develops and tests a drug that blocks a key protein found in cancers caused by human papillomavirus.
This project studies how exposure to opioids before birth changes brain structure and function and behavior as children grow.
This project makes nanoparticles that carry payloads and are joined to antibodies to help treat patients with lupus nephritis.
This project studies how muscle progenitor cells differ from adult satellite cells so stem cells can be turned into more regenerative muscle cells.
This project tests whether targeting a gene called ZNF410 can switch fetal hemoglobin back on in red blood cells to treat sickle cell disease.
This project tests whether a thermography approach that detects heat can find pressure injuries early in patients within routine nursing care.
This project builds deep learning models that use a woman's earlier mammograms to detect breast cancer more accurately and estimate risk.
This project tests a Deuterium MRI method for imaging how the brain handles glucose in people with Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds proteomic tools that link enzymes that modify proteins to their targets and shows how viruses rewire these networks to cause infection.
This project collects a large set of human movement data and builds artificial intelligence tools to help diagnose and treat conditions that limit movement.
This project develops nanoparticles, imaging methods and engineered immune cells to improve how cancer is detected and treated.
This project uses imaging and machine learning to predict how patients with glioblastoma will do and when the tumor may come back.
This project studies how RNA-based systems in germ cells tell self from non-self RNAs to protect the genome across generations.
This project designs a hydrogel containing fibers that mimics the mechanics of the natural cell matrix to grow more effective stem cells.
This project studies how mutations in the BRAF gene change gene regulation in the cells where serrated colon tumors start.
